A '''press cake''' is a low-value [[food]] item [[screw_press|pressed]] from an [[oil]]-producing [[seed]] or [[fruit|olive]] at a rate of one press cake per unit of oil.  It is a by-product of the pressing process, consisting of the leftover solids from the base material.

Press cakes will be used in the [[kitchen]] when 'prepare meal' tasks are queued, if they are enabled in the [[Status#Kitchen_Status_Screen|Kitchen tab]] in the Status screen.

[[File:sesame_press_cake.jpg|thumb|290px|center|Generally not a human food...]]

To press oil from the various seed crops - all except olives - the seed must first be [[miller|milled]] into paste at a millstone or quern. Only this intermediate product can be pressed. Olives can be pressed directly.
